chunks: Muhammad ibn Muslim narrated from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام:

He was asked about a man who entered the prayer with the Imam while being behind by one rakʿah. When the Imam completed the prayer, he left with the people, then afterward remembered that one rakʿah had been missed. He said: “He repeats one rakʿah.”

key_terms.الْإِمَامِ: the prayer leader in congregational salat
key_terms.بِرَكْعَةٍ: by one rakʿah, meaning one unit of prayer
key_terms.فَاتَتْهُ: was missed by him or escaped him
key_terms.وَاحِدَةً: one only, indicating a single rakʿah

ai.seo_question: What should a person do if he realizes after the Imam finishes that he missed one rakʿah in congregational prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about one who joins congregational salat after missing a rakʿah and later realizes that one unit of prayer remained incomplete. Imam Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام rules that he should make up one rakʿah, showing the obligation of completing the missed portion of the prayer.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1020 - Muhammad ibn Muslim narrated that Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) was asked about a man who entered the prayer with the Imam and was already behind by one rak'ah.

When the Imam completed the prayer and left with the congregation, the man remembered that he had missed one rak'ah.
Imam (as) said: "He should repeat one rak'ah."
